interpretation_limits: Warm-cache empty-window process restart; no optical first-frame or Finder request timing
qView 7.1 is latest stable verified by release page, API and remote git tag; nightly is not tested
Controlled source builds with qView main.cpp instrumentation; official distributed installers are not benchmarked
Fovelle probe sets system-quit/session flags then calls quit; qView probe directly calls quit; normal application cleanup retained
Neither image decode, session restoration, pending platform queries nor genuinely cold filesystem cache is included
A positive median startup difference remains in both matched-window and default-window batches; window geometry alone does not explain it
Both exit bootstrap intervals cross zero; observed small exit differences do not establish a reproducible performance advantage
Endpoint timings cannot attribute the remaining startup difference to specific library, decoder or feature; further stage profiling would be needed
